prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent PNG illustration sprite atlas for a premium editorial history-of-drawing website.
Primary request: Create SIX independent museum-quality fine graphite pencil art vignettes in an exact THREE-COLUMN by TWO-ROW grid. Highest available resolution, ideally 3072 by 2048 pixels, landscape 3:2 ratio. Native transparent alpha background throughout all unused space. No visible grid and no frames.
Layout: six EQUALLY SIZED cells, at x=0–33.333%, 33.333–66.666%, 66.666–100%; y=0–50%, 50–100%. Each illustration is centered within its own cell, contained within the inner 74% of its cell with generous transparent margins on all four sides. Nothing crosses cell boundaries. Every cell has approximately equal visual scale and density, drawn as an isolated floating cutout illustration. Keep the outer 13% of each cell entirely empty and transparent.
Top-left cell: prehistoric galloping horse in profile, primitive cave-art spirit but skillful fine graphite hatch marks, with two subtle red ochre handprints as one small restrained color group.
Top-middle cell: an ancient Egyptian profile artist hand poised beside a rolled papyrus and elegant lotus bloom, graphite with a tiny restrained vermilion accent.
Top-right cell: open medieval illuminated manuscript with an elegant feather quill and small botanical marginal drawing, all in graphite with one small restrained vermilion accent. Manuscript pages have no readable or invented text: use small ornamental graphical strokes only.
Bottom-left cell: Renaissance anatomical hand study, a beautifully drawn realistic human hand, delicate crosshatching and one geometric construction circle behind it, with one tiny restrained vermilion construction mark.
Bottom-middle cell: modern expressive graphite human portrait profile interspersed with abstract Cubist angular lines, with one tiny restrained vermilion accent.
Bottom-right cell: artist stylus and slim digital drawing tablet, a pencil sketch transforming into a small group of pixel blocks, with one tiny restrained vermilion accent.
Style: museum-quality hand-drawn illustration with masterful detailed graphite pencil hatch marks and delicate shading. Mostly monochrome dark warm graphite, warm charcoal black. Refined, sensitive, lightly worn archival drawing quality. Each vignette should feel like a thoughtful pencil study, not an icon, not clip art, not a vector. The six art subjects share one consistent graphite language.
Constraints: GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND WITH NATIVE ALPHA, no paper surface or off-white backdrop, no photograph of paper, no rectangular page behind an entire vignette, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no opaque halo. Empty areas between strokes remain transparent. No titles, no numbers, no labels, no letters, no watermarks, no borders, no frames, no cast shadows. Six separate vignettes, equal cell bounds, no touching or crossing cell boundaries.
